title: PH runner Naomi Cesar wins historic silver at Youth Olympic Games

blocks.text: DAKAR—Finishing fourth was never in her plans, so Naomi Marjorie Cesar saved her best for last and with an enormous burst of speed in the home stretch, snatched the women’s 800 meters silver behind an Ethiopian roadrunner for Team Philippines’ first medal at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games (YOG). “I worked so hard for this, so I told myself I’m not going to come home in fourth place,” said Cesar after one of the day’s athletics final witnessed by a jam-packed crowd at the Complexe Iba Mar Diop Stadium located in the heart of the Senegalese capital.
